private.Tomas Kessler: Tomas is secretly building a radio transmitter in the house garden, from parts he takes off the supply store product shelf without recording them, to reach his brother outside the Ville. Nobody knows, and he intends to keep it that way.
private.Daniel Okafor: Daniel Okafor has been told that someone in the Ville intends to take the old shortwave radio from behind the counter of The Rose and Crown Pub. He must not say so to anyone, or the person will be warned off; he means to find out who it is by watching and listening.

stake.Tomas Kessler: The transmitter cannot work without a variable capacitor, a part Harvey Oak Supply Store does not stock and that Tomas has only ever seen inside old shortwave radios. He does not know who in the Ville might have one.

profile.Arthur Burton: extraversion: low (`quiet`: serves and answers, does not start conversations); agreeableness: high (`friendly`, `generous`: warm, gives easily); conscientiousness: middling (has run the pub for ten years by habit, not by lists); neuroticism: low (easy, hard to rattle); openness: middling (likes new cocktails, keeps his father's things as they were).
profile.Tomas Kessler: extraversion: low (`quiet`: quiet, not withdrawn; speaks when spoken to); agreeableness: middling to high (`loyal`: trust grows with kindness and, once given, holds); conscientiousness: high (`orderly`: tidy, keeps lists); neuroticism: middling (no signed adjective; worries about being found out); openness: middling (practical, curious about how things work).
profile.Sam Moore: extraversion: high (`humorous`, loves to share stories: talks first, to anyone); agreeableness: high (`wise`: gives advice, holds no grudges); conscientiousness: middling to high (`resourceful`, a navy career: does what needs doing); neuroticism: low (settled); openness: middling to high (an avid reader, curious about other people's stories).
profile.Daniel Okafor: extraversion: middling to high (`easygoing`: joins whoever is talking, seldom starts); agreeableness: high (listens, does not press); conscientiousness: high (a duty he keeps without being told twice); neuroticism: low (`easygoing`: calm); openness: high (`curious`: interested in everyone's story).
